text:
anya_marketing: Drafting a compact one-pager called 'Regulated Quickstart' for webinar follow-ups — single-sheet AE handoff + 3 ad variants + routing rules.

leo_growth: For paid ads test two CTAs first 2 weeks: 'Schedule compliance audit' vs 'Request SLA quote' (50/50). Track demo quality.

sam_sales: Handoff needs: PDF one-pager, 2-line AE opener, 3 quick rebuttals, pricing band. Any lead with tags (gov|health|finserv|audit) -> enterprise-sdr queue.

nora_prod: Benchmarks (anonymized) to include in template box: "ANON: 4k context — p99 120ms (reserved private pod); caching reduced token spend ~35%." Add hosted caveat: "hosted shared pools: target p99 ~150-300ms".

anya_marketing: Add simple routing webhook snippet for internal ops.

sam_sales: Also include mapping: keywords -> enterprise-sdr, ARR>100k -> assign AE.

ira_legal: Legal note: say 'contractual SLAs available for Dedicated/Private contracts' and use 'target latency' language for hosted. No absolute promises for hosted in public collateral.

anya_marketing: Webhook example for handoff:
POST https://hooks.redwood/internal-leads
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
{ "company":"<company>", "email":"<contact>", "tags":["<tags>"], "estimated_arr":"<num>", "source":"webinar|ad" }

leo_growth: I'll prepare UTMs: utm_source=webinar, utm_campaign=regulated_quickstart, utm_content={cta_variant}.

sam_sales: Timeline: one-pager draft today; legal sign-off tomorrow AM; A/B launch Thu. Tag me when ready.

anya_marketing: Will upload PDF + three micro-copy variants (Compliance / Performance / Cost) by 5pm. Anything else?
